text:
sarah_devex: Quick heads-up — release cutoff for devex SDK/docs/sampleapps is 48h from now. Can folks drop a one-line status so we can decide whether to roll or hold? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

chris_sdk: SDK: packaging ✅, CI green but I found one flaky test in mac wheel build. Working on patch, should be done in 3-4hrs. No changelog ops needed from my side. :white_check_mark:

anya_docs: Docs: PRs for quickstart and API surface are merged but I still need to add the migration note for the new config flag. Should land today, ETA ~6hrs. Will ping when live. :pencil2:

jamal_eng: Sample apps: updated Node + Python samples to new init flow; however sample-app-voice still depends on the preview model and needs a small env var tweak. I can patch it this afternoon. Question: do we want the sample to call out the new batching recommendations?

sarah_devex: @jamal_eng yes, please add a short note in quickstarts about batching config (recommended defaults). Keep it 1-2 lines.

carlo_infra: Infra: dedicated test pool for this release is up. Deploy-bot ran smoke deploy to staging and reported one timeout on the embeddings route under load test 3. Re-ran, it passed. I left a note in the deploy logs.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging smoke passed (6/7 checks). Flaky: embeddings-load-test (timeout at 29s). Full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1719456789-smoke

chris_sdk: @carlo_infra can you paste the exact timeout stack? I want to see if packaging or client retries could hide it.

carlo_infra: stack snippet: 
```
TimeoutError: Request timed out after 30s
 at fetch (/repo/node_modules/fetch/index.js:142:15)
 at retry (/repo/infra/retry.js:45:12)
```
Looks like the client retry wasn't triggered because the process was saturated. We'll re-run with a larger pool.

anya_docs: Noted on batching — I'll add a single sentence + link to optimize page. Also updating changelog draft with the new flag name and sample diffs.

jamal_eng: Patch queued for sample-app-voice. Also adding a short snippet in README for env var TOUCHOFF_MODE=true to avoid preview model during smoke runs.

sarah_devex: Risk check: any breaking API changes?

chris_sdk: No breaking changes. Minor param rename behind feature flag. Backwards compatible.

sarah_devex: Ok. Decision deadline: 12hrs from thread (we'll do a final public cut if infra smoke passes and all PRs merged). If anyone expects a delay, drop an explicit hold now.

jamal_eng: I expect to finish the sample patch in time. No hold from me.

anya_docs: Will finish docs and changelog update in time, no hold.

carlo_infra: I'll re-run the embedding load test in 2hrs and post results.

chris_sdk: Patch for mac build submitted, looks small. If it fails CI I'll flag immediately.

sarah_devex: Great — thanks everyone. I'll do a final pre-cut checklist 1hr before cutoff and post here. :rocket:
